items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Jim Robinson and Jim Lindler and all them, we was playing in the old Chester band.

ctx.x: Now you must be known up top of them. Yes, I never knew that hall. People tell us about that hall. Yeah. Used to call it the Grove Hall. Did you ever play any dance work any place for dances or just the brass band? Oh, brass band used to play the dances. They played the dances too? Sure.

Sure used to play the dances out there. Sometimes the brass band would play the dances and sometimes the string band played the dances. Jim Robinson and Jim Lindler and all them, we was playing in the old Chester band. Yeah, string band.
What kind of music did you use for the dance? Did you have any waltzes or what kind of music did they use?
